title: SRE dashboards + alerts for kernel selector v2 (version breakdown, kernel-choice heatmaps, tail-latency monitors)
creator: Aisha Bello
description:
Goal
Add SRE-ready dashboard panels + alerting so we can safely roll out kernel selector v2 and quickly attribute regressions to selector version / kernel choice / GPU SKU / seq bucket.

Scope (what we need)
1) Selector version breakdown
- Dashboard: request + token metrics split by selector_version (v1 vs v2), environment (hosted/dedicated), region, gpu_sku_bucket, model_family, seq_bucket.
- Must work under cardinality limits (no raw model_id).
- Primary outcome: during canary we can answer “is v2 actually getting traffic?” + “are errors/latency isolated to v2?”

2) Kernel-choice heatmaps
- Dashboard: heatmap/table of kernel_id chosen by (gpu_sku_bucket x seq_bucket) for a given model_family (dropdown) and selector_version.
- Secondary view: kernel choice distribution over time (stacked area) for top N kernel_ids.
- Primary outcome: catch unexpected kernel distribution shifts after registry updates / config changes.

3) Tail-latency monitors
- Alerts for p95 and p99 latency regressions with selector_version breakdown.
- Must monitor separately for prefill vs decode (seq_bucket) where available.
- Should include “latency variance” / dispersion signal for mixed fleets (A10/L4 are common pain points).

Out of scope
- Adding new telemetry fields (tracked in ENG-3927), except minimal dashboard query glue.
- Perf-canary CI gating (ENG-3930).

Proposed dashboards
- Runtime Performance (Selector v2) — new section in the existing Runtime Performance dashboard:
  - Traffic split: selector_version by region + tier
  - Error rate: 5xx + runtime errors by selector_version
  - Latency: p50/p95/p99 by selector_version, split prefill/decode
  - Token throughput: tok/s by selector_version (bucketed)
  - Kernel heatmap: kernel_id vs gpu_sku_bucket & seq_bucket
  - “Top regressions” table: gpu_sku_bucket + model_family + seq_bucket sorted by p95 delta vs baseline

Alerts (initial thresholds; tune after first canary)
- Hosted canary (5% cohort) alerting:
  - Page: p95 latency +15% for >= 15 min AND selector_version=v2 contributes >= 30% of traffic in that slice
  - Page: p99 latency +20% for >= 10 min AND selector_version=v2
  - Page: error rate (5xx or runtime_error) +0.3% absolute for >= 10 min AND selector_version=v2
  - Ticket: kernel distribution shift > 25% for a model_family+gpu_sku_bucket+seq_bucket over 30 min window (non-paging; used to catch config/reg changes)

Cardinality constraints / bucketing
- Use gpu_sku_bucket (L4, A10, A100, H100, Other) not raw PCI IDs.
- Use model_family not model_id. Allow optional “model_name_bucket” only for top-level sanity checks (top 10).
- seq_bucket: prefill_short / prefill_long / decode_short / decode_long (exact bucket naming per telemetry standards doc).
- kernel_id should be capped: either top N kernel_id per view or grouped “other” bucket.

Implementation notes
- Datadog dashboards + monitors (preferred for paging), with links embedded into the rollout checklist doc.
- Ensure all monitors include runbook links (kernel-selector override/rollback runbook) and dashboard deep links.

Acceptance criteria
- New dashboard section live and linked from the selector v2 rollout checklist.
- During a synthetic test / internal canary, oncall can identify:
  - whether v2 is enabled
  - which kernel_id is being chosen
  - whether regression is isolated to specific gpu_sku_bucket and seq_bucket
- Paging alerts fire on induced regression test (temporarily lowered thresholds in staging) and include:
  - selector_version
  - region
  - gpu_sku_bucket
  - link to dashboard
- All queries comply with agreed label bucketing (no explosions; review with Thomas Baird if needed).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard: traffic/error/latency panels broken down by selector_version (v1 vs v2) with gpu_sku_bucket + model_family + seq_bucket filters
Dashboard: kernel-choice heatmap (kernel_id by gpu_sku_bucket x seq_bucket) for selected model_family, plus time-series distribution for top kernel_ids
Monitors: p95/p99 latency and error-rate regression monitors scoped to selector_version=v2, with runbook + dashboard links
Cardinality verified: no raw model_id, no raw GPU device identifiers, kernel_id grouped/capped where needed
Rollout checklist updated with links to dashboards/monitors and “what to look at first” pointers
